# Pull Request Style Guide

## Pull Request Instructions

When creating or updating a pull request:

- Use British English.
- Follow the repository's existing pull request template and contribution guidance.
- Start the title with an appropriate Gitmoji and a concise description of the change.
- Explain what changed and why, link related issues where applicable, and report
  validation performed and its results. State explicitly if tests were not run.
- If no repository template exists, use Summary and Testing sections.
- Request a review from GitHub Copilot where available; this does not replace
  required human review.
- If GitHub Copilot generated the body, add this visible attribution at the top:
  `This pull request body was generated by GitHub Copilot.`
- Do not add a hardcoded personal sign-off. Follow repository requirements
  for commit sign-off, using the actual contributor's identity.
